item.title: Operando and multiscale insights into the solid electrolyte interphase in lithium-mediated nitrogen reduction
item.description:
این مقاله با روش‌های operando و چندمقیاسی، بینش‌هایی درباره فصل مشترک الکترولیت جامد در احیای نیتروژن با واسطه لیتیوم ارائه می‌دهد.
Nature Reviews Chemistry | ⭐ Review
💡 This Review is the first to frame the solid electrolyte interphase as a dynamic regulator—not passive layer—governing Li+ transport, N2 access, and proton delivery in lithium-mediated nitrogen reduction. Its novelty lies in proposing an integrated operando, in situ, and multiscale characterization framework, combining complementary techniques to resolve SEI composition, structure, and evolution, thereby guiding rational SEI design for efficient, selective, durable ammonia electrosynthesis.
🏷 solid electrolyte interphase · lithium-mediated nitrogen reduction · operando · multiscale · SEI

item.title: Hidden Solid-Liquid Interfacial Failure Governs Fast-Charging Degradation in Large-Capacity Semi-Solid-State Lithium-Ion Batteries
item.description:

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study reveals that hidden solid-liquid interfacial failure, not bulk degradation, drives fast-charging aging in large-capacity semi-solid-state lithium-ion batteries. By uncovering this interfacial mechanism, it provides critical insight for designing durable high-rate batteries, advancing practical fast-charging deployment of high-energy semi-solid-state systems.

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in synergistically coupling paraelectric phase engineering with boundary precipitation in NaNbO3-based ceramics. This dual strategy simultaneously enhances energy efficiency and dielectric breakdown strength, overcoming a key trade-off in dielectric capacitors. The work offers a promising design route for high-performance, lead-free energy storage materials.

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a soft coral-inspired hyperbranched LiPAA-TG binder creating a rigid-flexible network that combines stress adaptability with rapid lithium-ion transport. Its significance is enabling silicon anodes to achieve 1049 cycles at 80% capacity retention in NCM613-Si/C@graphite pouch cells, addressing silicon's pulverization and slow kinetics for practical high-energy batteries.

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work uniquely combines crystal-facet modulation with Mg doping in LiMn0.6Fe0.4PO4 cathodes, a dual-engineering approach not previously reported. The synergy enhances lithium-ion transport and structural stability, delivering high capacity, superior rate capability, and long cyclability. It offers a promising design strategy for advanced olivine cathode materials in high-performance lithium-ion batteries.

💡 The novelty lies in using fluidized electron-beam evaporation to apply a scalable, solvent-free, dual-side LiAlF4 nano-coating on sulfide electrolytes. Its significance is enabling high-voltage, air-stable sulfide all-solid-state batteries with a manufacturable coating process, advancing practical commercialization of high-energy-density ASSBs.

item.description:

Small Structures | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Medium-entropy doping of NASICON Na₃V₂(PO₄)₃ activates the V⁴⁺/V⁵⁺ couple, enabling stepwise multielectron redox (Ti, Fe, V) over 1.5–4.6 V. This yields 160.1 mAh g⁻¹, 475 Wh kg⁻¹, and 100% capacity retention after 4000 cycles at 20 C, while reducing vanadium content. It establishes medium-entropy engineering as a viable strategy for high-performance polyanion cathodes.

Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in a dual-network hydrogel electrolyte combining polyacrylamide, chitosan, and 2D vermiculite nanosheets to simultaneously tackle polyiodide shuttling and zinc dendrites. Its significance is enabling shuttle-free, dendrite-inhibited Zn–I₂ batteries with 97.4% retention over 10,000 cycles and stable pouch cells, offering a promising strategy for durable aqueous energy storage.
